description:
Night recording in the Trésor Nature Reserve, French Guiana.
Distant Watson’s scops owl, toads and frogs, including grass frogs, and crickets. 
Light drops of water falling from the foliage.

Recorder MixPre6 II
ORTF Setup: 2 x CCM4 Schoeps Microphones in a Cinela windscreen
Original Recording in Wave, 96kHz, 24bit
GPS 4.609954, -52.279268
REF: GUY-260126-07
Date: 26 January 2026

Recorded during a guided night walk led by Timothé Le Pape of Jungle by Night.
Recorded during a residency at Guyane Art Factory, Cayenne, French Guiana, in January 2026.
name: Night Frogs and Crickets in the Forest -Trésor Nature Reserve, French Guiana
